question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice**.

The judge said that the defendant’s plea of not guilty had been a waste of the court’s time, as the evidence which had been presented by the prosecution had clearly proven that he was guilty.

options.text: "The defendant’s plea of not guilty was a waste of the court’s time, as the evidence which was presented by the prosecution has clearly proven that he is guilty," the judge said.
"The defendant’s plea of not guilty has been a waste of the court’s time, as the evidence which was presented by the prosecution has clearly proven that he is guilty," the judge said.
"The defendant’s plea of not guilty has been a waste of the court’s time, as the evidence which was presented by the prosecution had clearly proven that he was guilty," the judge said.
"The defendant’s plea of not guilty had been a waste of the court’s time, as the evidence which was presented by the prosecution had clearly proven that he was guilty," the judge said.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. "The defendant’s plea of not guilty has been a waste of the court’s time, as the evidence which was presented by the prosecution has clearly proven that he is guilty," the judge said. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question asks for the sentence to be expressed in **direct voice**, where the speaker’s exact words are quoted.
 
• Option 2 retains the direct quotation format and aligns with the original meaning provided in the sentence.
 
• The direct voice in Option 2 correctly uses the verb tense to reflect the prosecution's evidence and the defendant's plea.

Correct sentence: *"The defendant’s plea of not guilty has been a waste of the court’s time, as the evidence which was presented by the prosecution has clearly proven that he is guilty," the judge said.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direct Voice:** Represents the speaker's exact words, enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• **Indirect Voice:** Paraphrases the speaker's words, often with adjustments to verb tense and pronouns.
 
• **Key Difference:** Direct voice maintains the original phrasing, while indirect voice focuses on conveying the meaning.
